sources.title: Introducing Claude 2.1
sources.evidence: The November 21, 2023 announcement releases Claude 2.1 with 200,000-token context, system prompts and beta API tool use. Reopened for the October 27 parameter re-audit; the release describes capabilities and context length, with no nominal total or activated parameter specification.

sources.title: Model Card and Evaluations for Claude Models, with Claude 2.1 appendix
sources.evidence: Page 1 identifies the Claude 2 Transformer architecture. Page 15 says Claude 2.1 is not a new base model and increases supported context from 100K to 200K. No nominal total or active parameter count is stated for either Claude 2.0 or 2.1. The complete fresh alternate copy was independently inspected in this pass (s12).

sources.title: The Claude 3 Model Family: Opus, Sonnet, Haiku
sources.evidence: The initial audit checked indexed excerpts of this original Claude 3 PDF after retrieval limitations. The complete official combined card, including later addenda, was subsequently obtained and independently rechecked in this pass (s10); its Claude 2.1 comparisons report performance, not parameter counts.

sources.title: Expanded legal protections and improvements to our API
sources.evidence: December 19, 2023 article ties Claude API use to commercial terms and demonstrates claude-2.1 in both completion and Messages API requests. It says robust function calling would come to the Messages API later.

sources.title: Anthropic on Amazon Bedrock Commercial Terms of Service, December 2023
sources.evidence: Contemporaneous terms linked by s4 grant conditional service use, restrict reverse engineering and duplication, and reserve intellectual property rights. They establish proprietary commercial service terms, but do not explicitly state Claude 2.1 weight-download availability.

sources.title: Model deprecations
sources.evidence: Deprecation history identifies claude-2.1 as retired from the Anthropic API on July 21, 2025.

sources.title: Supported foundation models in Amazon Bedrock, indexed historical table
sources.evidence: The indexed historical official table explicitly lists Anthropic Claude 2.1, anthropic.claude-v2:1, Text input and Text/Chat output. The live URL now redirects to a migration page; this verifies historical modalities, not current availability.

sources.title: Claude 3.7 Sonnet and Claude Code
sources.evidence: The February 24, 2025 release introduces a hybrid reasoning model with configurable extended thinking. It does not establish a Claude 2.1 dedicated reasoning mode.

sources.title: Third-party testing in AI policy
sources.evidence: Anthropic describes itself as primarily developing proprietary systems. This is company-level evidence and is insufficient on its own to verify the exact Claude 2.1 weight-release status.

sources.title: Claude 3 family card with later addenda
sources.evidence: Independently searched and read the relevant sections of the complete official 46.8 MB PDF freshly fetched by the parent at 2026-10-27T10:09:00.971358+00:00. Claude 2.1 appears in multilingual MMLU, factual-accuracy, QuALITY and needle-in-a-haystack comparisons, including the June 2024 addendum. These report accuracy, recall and preference scores; no nominal total or activated-parameter column is supplied. The qualitative statement that size scales from Haiku to Opus gives no count and no Claude 2.1 lineage.

sources.title: Responsible Scaling Policy, Version 1.0
sources.evidence: The policy explicitly classifies Claude 2 as ASL-2 and requires protecting model weights as core intellectual property, limiting access by job function and preventing unsanctioned release. The exact 2.1 appendix says it is not a new base model; together with contemporaneous proprietary terms, this supports restricted weight access for that revision.

sources.title: Model Card and Evaluations for Claude Models, complete Claude 2.1 appendix copy
sources.evidence: Independently inspected the complete text from the official PDF freshly fetched by the parent at 2026-10-27T10:08:59.113641+00:00. The page 15 appendix explicitly identifies Claude 2.1 as additional functionality on Claude 2.0, not a new base model. This establishes named lineage, but neither version has a nominal total or activated count in the card. Figure 6 places research preference models and pretrained LMs on a parameter axis separately from the Claude performance bars; it does not assign a Claude parameter count. No structural-change disclosure supplies a different count.

sources.title: Claude 3.7 Sonnet System Card
sources.evidence: Searched the complete official PDF text freshly fetched by the parent at 2026-10-27T10:08:59.439841+00:00 and inspected the model/training sections. No Claude 2.1 parameter specification or activated-parameter comparison was located. The later card does not resolve either count for this older model.

sources.title: Scaling Monosemanticity: Extracting Interpretable Features from Claude 3 Sonnet
sources.evidence: Fresh targeted interpretability searches were followed by inspection of the primary article text in the shared fresh cache; direct web-reader opening exceeded its content limit. The article studies the production March 2024 Claude 3 Sonnet and explicitly withholds that model size. Its 1M, 4M and 34M numbers count sparse-autoencoder features, not Claude parameters. This is not Claude 2.1 or its named base and supplies no transferable count.

sources.title: Benchmarking LLMs’ Judgments With No Gold Standard
sources.evidence: Fresh searches surfaced a roughly 137B Claude 2 claim. This independent benchmark paper lists anthropic/claude-2 as approximately 137B and explicitly defines the tilde as an estimated size. It is secondary evidence about Anthropic specifications, not a developer disclosure, and does not establish a nominal Claude 2.0 or 2.1 total or active count. The estimate is not adopted.

family.note: The 2.1 appendix explicitly relates this revision to Claude 2.0.

release_date.note: Dated announcement states the model is available that day.

open_weights.note: Restricted weights supported jointly by the exact 2.1 statement that it is not a new base model, Claude 2 weight-containment policy, and contemporaneous proprietary terms. This is not inferred from API delivery alone.

license.note: Commercial service terms, including restricted duplication and reserved IP, support this classification. This is not a publicly downloadable weight license.

parameters_b.note: Fresh original-card, later comparison-card and targeted first-party searches found no published nominal total for Claude 2.1 or its explicitly named Claude 2.0 base. The same-base statement would support a nominal-size inference if a supported base count were available; the remaining gap is that count, not an exact tensor census. Research-model plots, later Sonnet autoencoder feature counts and a third-party approximately 137B estimate do not establish it.

active_parameters_b.note: Rechecked separately for a published active or activated count, including later first-party comparison tables and interpretability material. No Claude 2.1 or named-base active count or relevant activated-parameter column was found. Performance scores and SAE feature counts are not active model parameters; no total-to-active equality is assumed.

architecture.note: Base-model architecture is explicit; the 2.1 appendix says this is not a new base model. Dense/MoE and decoder-only details remain unestablished.

context_window.note: Supported 2.1 context, distinct from the initial 2.0 product limit.

modalities.note: Exact historical Claude 2.1 provider row documents Text input and Text/Chat output, corroborated by Anthropic text API examples. Chat is represented as text.

reasoning.note: No exact-model dedicated thinking-mode specification was located. General reasoning ability or later Claude extended thinking does not establish this boolean.

tool_call.note: Launch beta supports developer-defined functions/APIs. The later Messages API announcement calls robust function calling forthcoming; do not imply every API surface had the later standardized tool interface.

description.value: Anthropic Claude 2 revision with a 200K-token context window, system prompts and beta tool use.
description.note: Replaces the generic historical label with documented distinguishing features.

patch.description: Anthropic Claude 2 revision with a 200K-token context window, system prompts and beta tool use.
patch.notes: No nominal total or active count is disclosed for Claude 2.1 or its explicitly identified Claude 2.0 base in the reviewed primary sources. Transformer is documented, but dense/MoE routing is not established. Tool use was beta; Messages API function calling was still forthcoming in December 2023. Weight access is restricted under Claude 2 containment policy and proprietary terms; the 2.1 appendix identifies the same base model. Anthropic retired claude-2.1 on July 21, 2025; historical capabilities do not establish a currently served endpoint.

sources.label: Claude 3 family card with later addenda

summary: Parameter re-audit: total and active counts remain undisclosed. The original appendix establishes Claude 2.0 lineage, but no supported nominal base count was found in the fresh original, later comparison or interpretability checks; third-party size estimates are not adopted. Other audited fields are unchanged.
